definition.text: (Gen. 6:4; Num. 13:33, R.V.), giants, the Hebrew word left untranslated by the Revisers, the name of one of the Canaanitish tribes. The Revisers have, however, translated the Hebrew gibborim, in Gen. 6:4, “mighty men.”

works.title: Ante-Nicene Fathers, Volume 2: Fathers of the Second Century

chapters.title: Chapter XXIV.—Concerning the Angels and Giants
